newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU seeks BA /AA tie-up details.
newsitem.headline: EU seeks BA /AA tie-up details.

text.p: The European Commission has formally asked British Airways for detail of the airline's planned tie-up with AMR Corp's American Airlines, part of the executive's ongoing probe into six transatlantic alliances.
"It's a purely procedural decision which goes to the parties to inform them of what we are looking at," Commission spokeswoman Sarah Lambert said.
"It will have gone to everybody whose alliance we are looking at," she added, a reference to the five other alliances under review.

The Commission last July launched its probe into BA/American's tie-up, along with parallel probes into deals between Germany's Lufthansa and United Airlines, between Scandinavia's SAS and United Airlines, Swissair /Belgium's Sabena /Austrian Airlines and Delta Air Lines Inc, Dutch airline KLM and Northwest Airlines Corp and between British Airways and USAir.

The statement of objections formally details the Commission's concerns about the different transatlantic alliances, many of which were made clear in July when Commissioners Karel Van Miert and Neil Kinnock announced the alliance inquiries over the summer.
The planned BA/American deal is also currently under investigation by the British and U.S. competition authorities.
